scripts.build: npm run check-encoding && npx vite build --config src/renderer/vite.config.ts && electron-vite build || true
scripts.build:refboard: (cmake -S refboard-d2d -B refboard-d2d/build && cmake --build refboard-d2d/build --config Release) || (call refboard-d2d\build_refboard.bat 2>nul || echo cmake and MSVC both unavailable - using prebuilt binary if exists)
scripts.dist: node scripts/gen-licenses.js && npm run build && npm run build:refboard && electron-builder --win --config.forceCodeSigning=false
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/gen-licenses.js && npm run build && npm run build:refboard && electron-builder --win --dir --config.forceCodeSigning=false
